effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: Registered fixed original AR; no tuning
effective_config.selection_validation_policy: Retained old-class validation only; no selection

policies.ce: Existing inverse-current-minibatch-frequency class-balanced CE for every CE term, including DER++.
policies.cost: training_seconds is synchronized wall time for optimization only, cumulative across completed checkpoints; selection/evaluation seconds separate. Failed/interrupted attempts remain in logs and are not counted in successful training totals.
policies.derpp: Unchanged CE+alpha logit MSE+beta replay CE and two independent minibatches;180 training plus20 validation slots/class. Old attack samples/logits retained; refreshed Normal target logits computed under the current post-task model.
policies.error_flow: Mutually exclusive incorrect predictions: Normal first, then a class introduced later than the true class, then other old/same-task classes.
policies.evaluation: Task-known seen-label set at checkpoint, no task identity at inference; future/unseen true classes excluded. All supported seen classes reported, no recall floor exclusions.
policies.freq: Original cumulative seen-class TRAIN counts only;20 slots/class plus remaining capacity proportional to counts, largest remainder with lower class-ID ties; multiclass simplification, not exact ECBRS.
policies.herding_storage: Current-class rows are gathered one inference batch at a time; float32 embeddings are preallocated or temporarily memory-mapped. The historical herding_select mean, dot products, order, precision and selection steps are unchanged.
policies.joint: Offline upper-bound exception: fresh initialization each task on all seen TRAIN rows excluding common holdout; revisits old attacks, unlike deployment methods; not one of seven replay methods.
policies.memory: M=200*seen classes includes training replay and retained validation. Requested per-class quota may exceed200; unavailable rows leave capacity unused.
policies.replay_count_scope: replay_examples/bytes fields measure optimization replay only; allocation.actual_total includes retained validation. Selection time includes validation scoring and archive sampling.
policies.resource_measurement: CUDA allocated/reserved peaks cover optimization only, not exemplar selection or evaluation; host RAM peak is not measured. Large exemplar embedding matrices use temporary disk-backed mmap, whose resident file pages remain OS-managed.
policies.rng: Deterministic task-local seed = seed*10000+task_index; checkpoint-boundary resume uses exactly the same task-local seed.
policies.scope: Section26.9 benign stream available/old attacks inaccessible deployment comparison under RQ2/RO2; Joint explicitly offline; no OFRA motivation or RQ1/RQ3 completion.
policies.selection_change_from_history: Section26.9: Normal training/validation pools are refreshed each task with common task-dependent RNG; old attacks use stored replay/validation only, never old attack pools. New attacks use current-task TRAIN only.
policies.validation: Permanent max(5,ceil(10%)) per-class TRAIN holdout. Allocation uses old retained validation and at most20 heldout rows for each new class; retained validation is counted inside M.
